Frieren Desk: what it is and how to use it

Long image

A

Answer

Frieren Desk is a chibi pet on your Hyprland desktop. You type in the chat and she operates the system through opencode: she runs commands, edits files and even answers with voice.

  1. It lives on the desktop with Quickshell, reacts to events and minimizes to the tray.
  2. Each message runs opencode run with a dedicated agent; history and telemetry go to SQLite.
  3. It replies in the language you write in, with three female voices to choose from.
  4. Install with ./install.sh and open the chat with SUPER + SHIFT + R.

1

How is it built?

Diagram structure
  • User user
  • PetSprite pet
  • ChatPanel chat
  • ShellRoot shell
  • opencode run opencode
  • frieren.db db
  • frieren-tray tray
  • user → pet · click and gestures
  • user → chat · type and drop files
  • pet → shell · toggle and fresh
  • chat → shell · submit
  • shell → opencode · run --format json
  • opencode → shell · JSON events
  • shell → db · history and turns
  • tray → shell · IPC and state
  1. ChatPanel ↗

    Type or dictate with the mic; / suggests commands and @window adds the focused window.

  2. opencode run ↗

    It runs with the frieren agent; the pet changes pose as events arrive.

  3. frieren.db ↗

    Text returns to the chat, the chime plays, and the turn is stored.

2

What are all the poses?

reading and celebrate were generated from the prompt in assets/SPRITE_PROMPT.md with idle.png as reference, keyed from magenta and cropped to 228x256 with transparency. reading eyes have blink rects; celebrate keeps its eyes closed and never blinks.

3

How do I make it speak?

VoiceLanguageHow to get it
en-jennyEnglish (GB, female)Already installed
en-lessacEnglish (US, female)frieren-voice download en-lessac
es-danielaSpanish (AR, female)frieren-voice download es-daniela

frieren-voice use <id> or /voice <id> selects a voice; /voice on|off toggles spoken replies and /volume 10-150 sets the volume. The engine is piper-tts (paru -S piper-tts).
